newsitem.title: UK: Maizels, Westerberg & Co hires partner from RTZ.
newsitem.headline: Maizels, Westerberg & Co hires partner from RTZ.

text.p: Anglo-Scandinavian investment bank Maizels, Westerberg & Co said on Monday it had appointed RTZ Corp Plc executive Rod Colwell as a partner and joint managing director in London.
"He will concentrate on developing MW & Co's international M&A business," the company said in a statement.

Colwell, 48, was managing director of RTZ Development Enterprises and was with the company for two years. He was responsible for coordinating RTZ's $20 billion merger with CRA of Australia, the company said.
Prior to that he was a director at Merrill Lynch in London, having joined the newly formed European M&A team in 1984.
